note: Made-up test data. Not real listings: areas are real Edinburgh districts, but streets, house numbers and descriptions are invented, and postcodes use inward letters Royal Mail never issues (C, I, K, M, O, V), so they can't match a real address. A studio has 0 bedrooms. rentPcm is whole pounds per calendar month.

properties.description: Bright second-floor tenement flat with high ceilings and a bay-windowed living room. Dining kitchen to the rear, gas central heating and a shared drying green.

Second-floor flat in a recently built development, with a lift and an allocated parking bay. Close to bus routes and the Royal Infirmary.

Modern detached home backing onto woodland, with an integral garage and a south-facing garden. Main bedroom suite with a dressing room.
Lower maisonette with its own garden and a private entrance. Walking distance to the tram, and busy on rugby weekends.
Contemporary three-storey townhouse near the loch, with a roof terrace and a garage. Every bedroom has access to its own bathroom.
Smart flat beside the Botanic Garden, with a large living room and a study nook. Residents' parking is available.
Exceptional penthouse with a wraparound terrace and views to the castle. Five bedrooms, four bathrooms, a private lift and two secure parking spaces.
Tiny studio.

Handsome six-bedroom townhouse set over four floors on a private square, with a library, a cinema room and a mature garden with a summerhouse.

Long-term lets preferred. References and a guarantor may be required.

Upper maisonette with its own stair, a sunny balcony and a garage in a nearby block. No pets, please.
Converted farm steading on the edge of the city, with exposed beams, an open-plan living space and shared courtyard parking.

This generous three-bedroom apartment occupies the top floor of a handsome sandstone building a few minutes' walk from the station, and it has been completely refurbished by its current owners to a very high standard throughout. The hallway is wide and bright, with a run of fitted cupboards that provide plenty of storage for coats, cases and bicycles. At the front of the building, the living room stretches across the full width of the flat, with three tall sash windows, working shutters, restored cornicing and a marble fireplace with a gas stove. The dining kitchen sits to the rear and has been fitted with handmade timber units, stone worktops, an electric range cooker, a dishwasher, a washer-dryer and a large fridge-freezer, with room for a table that seats eight. The main bedroom is a large double with a wall of built-in wardrobes and an en suite shower room with underfloor heating. The second bedroom is another good double, also with fitted wardrobes, and the third bedroom is a comfortable single that would suit a home office equally well. A family bathroom completes the accommodation, with a freestanding bath and a separate walk-in shower. Outside, tenants share a large, well-kept back green with a drying area and a bike store, and a residents' parking permit is available from the council. The flat is let unfurnished, and gas central heating and double glazing to the rear are included. Sorry, no smokers. Available now for a minimum term of twelve months, subject to references and a deposit equal to five weeks' rent.
